title: A save whose 401 came after an upload that may have landed owes no retry, though a fresh token may mend it
evidence: Found building S57b. RecordSession's passFailed takes its cause from saveFailureCause (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts:458), which calls any 401 'auth' (packages/health-core/src/save-state.ts:126-129), so retryOwed is false (save-state.ts:118-120) and the web's retryDue (widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store.ts:213) says no upload will come. A 401 marked may-have-landed (write-refusal.ts mayHaveLanded) is Google Drive's verify read after its upload (drive-rest.ts:320-323, :538-547): no fresh token was tried, so signing in again is not yet known to be needed. Proposal: saveFailureCause treats a marked 401 as 'other', so a retry is owed. It is shared save-state (web and iPhone), so a design note first: how the web refreshes its Drive token on that retry, and what the web says meanwhile. The iPhone does not read retryDue: it saves again at the next edit or foreground (ios/engine/cloud.ts cloudVisible, record-session.ts flushSync), and S57b puts a fresh token on that call. US-09 AC30; US-11 AC3b
